description: This file implements transaction management for a key-value storage backend using BoltDB, including batch transaction handling, locking, bucket operations, and transaction commit logic.

classes.name: batchTx
classes.description: Represents a batch transaction with locking, pending operation tracking, and commit management.

classes.name: batchTxBuffered
classes.description: Extends batchTx with buffering capabilities and additional commit logic for buffered transactions.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the transaction, intended for use in unit tests.

methods.name: LockInsideApply
methods.description: Locks the transaction during inside-apply operations, with optional hook invocation.

methods.name: LockOutsideApply
methods.description: Locks the transaction during outside-apply operations, with validation.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the transaction, committing if pending operations exceed the batch limit.

methods.name: UnsafeCreateBucket
methods.description: Creates a new bucket within the transaction.

methods.name: UnsafeDeleteBucket
methods.description: Deletes a bucket within the transaction.

methods.name: UnsafePut
methods.description: Writes a key-value pair to a bucket within the transaction.

methods.name: UnsafeSeqPut
methods.description: Appends a key-value pair to a bucket, with fill percent optimization.

methods.name: UnsafeRange
methods.description: Retrieves a range of key-value pairs from a bucket.

methods.name: UnsafeDelete
methods.description: Deletes a key from a bucket.

methods.name: UnsafeForEach
methods.description: Iterates over all key-value pairs in a bucket.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Commits the current transaction and starts a new one.

methods.name: CommitAndStop
methods.description: Commits the current transaction without starting a new one.

methods.name: safePending
methods.description: Returns the number of pending operations in a thread-safe manner.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Performs the actual commit of the transaction, with optional stopping.

methods.name: newBatchTxBuffered
methods.description: Creates a new buffered batch transaction.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks buffered transaction, writing back buffers and conditionally committing.

methods.name: Commit
methods.description: Buffered transaction commit.

methods.name: CommitAndStop
methods.description: Buffered transaction commit without starting a new transaction.

methods.name: unsafeCommit
methods.description: Performs the internal commit logic for buffered transactions.

methods.name: UnsafePut
methods.description: Buffered put operation.

methods.name: UnsafeSeqPut
methods.description: Buffered sequential put operation.

methods.name: UnsafeDelete
methods.description: Buffered delete operation.

methods.name: UnsafeDeleteBucket
methods.description: Deletes a bucket in buffered transaction.
